comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsourced services provider paid a revenue share by a partner university; it doesn't operate institutions or enroll students itself.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Small single-state allied health campus operator; nursing overlaps, but it lacks the online and military focus and is regional.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: For-profit accredited university operator, mainly online adult students, Title IV funded, with health sciences programs.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates Strayer and Capella online and campus degrees for working adults, with military and employer channels like APEI.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual schools funded by public school payments, a different customer and funding model from adult postsecondary education.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Campus-based vocational trades training for recent high school graduates; similar funding, but a different programs and student base with no online or military focus.
